entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Astronomer Professor Rangi Matamua went to Antarctica to test a theory connected to te ao Māori, as captured in the new documentary Ranginui: Call of the Ice | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

He tells RNZ's Saturday Morning he came away with two new te reo terms for "very new" phenomena.

🎧 Listen to the full interview: https://www.rnz.co.nz/national/programmes/saturday/audio/2019042038/antarctica-through-a-te-ao-maori-lens
